name: edge-browser
description: Control Microsoft Edge through its first-party ChatGPT browser extension.

interface.shortDescription: Control Edge through the ChatGPT browser extension
interface.longDescription: Routes Codex browser work to Microsoft Edge through the first-party ChatGPT extension and the official Chrome plugin runtime, without macOS Accessibility. Requires chrome@openai-bundled to remain installed and enabled.
defaultPrompt: Use Edge Browser to work in Microsoft Edge without desktop Accessibility.
